description: This PHP class defines a GreaterThanOperator used for filtering in the SuiteCRM JSON API. It extends a base Operator class and implements methods to return filter and SQL representations of a 'greater than' comparison, as well as validating the operator input.

classes.name: GreaterThanOperator
classes.description: A filter operator class representing the 'greater than' comparison, capable of returning its filter and SQL string representations and validating input operators.

methods.name: toFilterOperator
methods.description: Returns the filter string 'gt' used to represent the 'greater than' operator in filters.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates that the provided operator is a string and delegates further validation to the parent class.
